en.hubeali:
A group of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> never spoke with the people with full power of his<sup>saww</sup> intellect at all’. 
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘We<sup>as</sup>, the group of Prophets<sup>as</sup>, have been Commanded that we<sup>as</sup> speak to the people in accordance to their intellects’’.
